XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Noise (ticking) coming from the front axle when turning at low speed

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: Vehicles equipped with lightweight brake discs

  • System: Brakes

  • Device: Front brake disc cup

  • Fault: Noise (ticking) coming from the front axle when turning at low speed in dry and hot conditions, WITHOUT braking

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Microscopic vibrations caused by small movements between the brake disc cup and the wheel support flange in the front axle, especially on the inner contact surface

• Procedure: Remove the brake discs from both front wheels and on each side of the wheel (left and right), insert a friction disc between the inner brake disc cup and the wheel support flange.

    Clean the discs with a brake cleaner, avoiding greasing them. Also clean both wheel support flanges without greasing them.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: If the vehicle in question is more than 2 years old, replace the front and rear axle wheel bolts.

    Adhesion disc code for vehicles with a hole circumference of 112 no. 34106884839
